_comment: Which recipients the per-agent listener may dispatch automatically (listener.py re-reads this on every scan; false = the listener idles). kimi is off by default: Kimi CLI -p applies its 'auto' permission policy without approval prompts (see kimi_headless.sh / README). dispatch_max_age_seconds: never-attempted messages older than this are not dispatched automatically (a human runs them; see `listener.py pending`); response_deadline is metadata and does not gate dispatch.
